title: Jaguar Land Rover to cut 4,000 jobs over two years in major cost-saving drive
summary_full: The luxury carmaker is targeting £1.7 billion ($2.3 billion) in savings as it faces Chinese competition, a cyberattack and U.S. tariffs.
